requirements.text: WP-024 owns a transaction-bound API accepting the caller's database connection: ensure immutable obligation key, ensure managed task, update current task/obligation state, append status history, audit/operation receipt and required reminder intent. It supplies uniqueness `(tenant, originKind, originMeeting, Person, obligationKind)`, protected source identity, one active managed task per obligation, current revision and explicit unowned state. Meeting evaluation tasks use separate meeting/kind identity and do not require Person. A no_longer_needed obligation persists even if its task is edited/soft-deleted and forbids regeneration; current source correction may mark applicability superseded with history. No outcome reporting, generic work flow interpreter, independent task transaction or provider call is required in this kernel. WP-022 invokes it in the same finalization UoW; direct dependency WP-024→WP-022 is mandatory. WP-023 owns later typed outcomes/contact/eligible ownership/handoff. Kernel closure proves physical constraints/replay/fault rollback with actual WP-022 consumer at that consumer's closure, not only a stub or final regression.

requirements.text: Use distinct LocalDate, entered LocalDateTime +IANA zone+selected offset and resolved UTC Instant. A date-only task remains due throughout its stored church-local day and becomes overdue at next local-day start, even on 23/25 hour DST days. A timed deadline compares resolved Instant; undated stays undated/Unknown. Entered gap time refuses save and asks for a valid choice; entered fold displays both offsets and requires occurrence selection. Automatic recurring wall schedules use resolver version 1: earlier occurrence on fold, shift forward by the actual gap duration on gap, once per logical period/recipient regardless of retry. All-day due notice engineering default 09:00 church-local on due day; overdue notice 09:00 next local day. A timed due notice is at deadline and overdue notice 24 elapsed hours later; reminders do not redefine deadline state. Meeting 7/3/1 offsets are civil days retaining local wall clock, with the same automatic resolver and disclosed labels. Future timezone change previews boundary/recurrence/reminder changes, commits preference+replanning intent under expected revision, preserves all stored LocalDate values/past instants/one-time future appointment instants, and does not resend delivered logical slots. Personal private-care weeks use confirmed author timezone separately; changing church zone never rekeys them. Runtime clock/asOf is injected/frozen and independent of host timezone; expiry/deletion uses elapsed UTC Instants.
